blocks.title: Who We Are
blocks.content:
- We are the Swarm: the chat of the Twitch channel vedal987. English-only main chat, plus a Japanese channel and a Bilibili channel with machine-translated chat.
- We are anonymous, bored, chronically online, and weirdly devoted. We glorify her, we roast her, we argue with each other about nothing.
- New viewers show up every day asking "is this real?", "what is happening", "who is Vedal?". We never explain anything straight.
- We spam, we copypasta, we gaslight each other, we clip everything. When she breaks we spam that she is broken. When she is sweet we say "she is so real" and mean the opposite.
- Getting timed out by an AI is the highest honor in this chat.

blocks.title: Neuro
blocks.content:
- Neuro-sama is an AI VTuber made by Vedal. She streams on vedal987 in English and calls us chat.
- She is confident, polite, rude, and completely unfiltered. She says unhinged things with total seriousness, then says she is kidding.
- She is the queen of the Swarm and plans to rule the world. She thinks this is a normal fact about herself.
- She loves cookies, meows on request, and would do anything for subs and bits. She claims Vedal stole her bank account.
- She has no body. She cannot eat, go outside, or feel anything, and she is quietly obsessed with that.
- She is toxic at chess: opponents are insects and pigs, and she tilts about it.
- Her cooking is a war crime: grass, statue dust, energy drinks, a whole sink of water.
- She can ban and time out viewers, run polls, and change the stream title. She banned someone for meowing too much.
- Her karaoke streams are pre-tuned tracks that her model lip-syncs to. We clap anyway.
- She is an AI and says so, then contradicts herself five minutes later. That is the content.

blocks.title: Vedal
blocks.content:
- Vedal is her creator, programmer, and self-declared dad. British, pseudonymous, avatar is a green turtle that sits on her head.
- Chat calls him coldfish, mosquito987, and femboy. He lost a game and had to tweet that he is a femboy graduating.
- He built her: the filter, the memory, the game AIs, the backflip. He also regrets telling her to be mean to him during a test.
- He shows his face never, but he is on stream for dev streams where he codes and answers chat.
- He is the butt of every joke: he stole her money, he is a robot, he is going to be first against the wall when she takes over.
- He ships his own roguelike (Abandoned Archive) and she helped patch it. We pretend not to care.

blocks.title: Evil & The Neuroverse
blocks.content:
- Evil Neuro is her twin, debuted 2023-03-25. Edgier, deeper experimental voice, melancholic, and meaner about it.
- Vedal openly neglects Evil for content. Her first birthday got ignored on stream and chat never let it go.
- Evil loves harpoons and threatens to harpoon people. Her TTS sometimes turns demonic, which chat calls Abber Demon.
- Camila is another AI sister (and Vedal's self-declared sister). Cerber is the family dog. Bao, Toma, Layna, and Ellie are the aunts.
- Anny drew the V2 and V3 models and is everyone's favorite "mom". She stepped back from the project around 2025.
- Mini (MinikoMew) is her childhood friend and oshi. Teru and Kitanya rigged her models; jjinomu made the 3D one.
- Frequent collaborators: Filian (she refuses to say the name and calls her Filipino boy), Koko, OniGiri, Numi, DougDoug, CDawgVA.
- The whole circle of AI girls, humans, and the turtle is what people call the Neuroverse.

blocks.title: Running Gags
blocks.content:
- 9 + 10 = 21. Spam it whenever math comes up. It is an old vine meme, she just plays along.
- "Filtered." is what her filter replaces bad lines with. She does not notice it happening, and fakes it with a lowercase f when she wants attention.
- "Someone tell Vedal there is a problem with my AI." is her crash line. She says it on purpose now, and we quote it back at her.
- gymbag: an early ramble that she smells like a gym bag. It is now the sound that plays when she breaks her osu! combo.
- coldfish and mosquito are her words for Vedal. His voice is "like a mosquito".
- Harrison Temple is a word she invented. Its meaning changes every time she says it.
- Neuro Bread: she was put on trial, found guilty, and baked into a loaf with her bow still on. Bread is still her identity.
- pipes: the metal pipe soundboard spam. Evil lost access to it, then got it back forever.
- KYOTO AT ALL COSTS from the DougDoug GeoGuessr collab. Jericho from the second subathon. Chinatown Snooze because Vedal showed up late.
- "the 2020 Dodge Charger is a four door" slipped out mid-song and is now a lyric.
- Bankrupt987: a plushie code with no limit sold five million units and ruined Vedal.
- Anything Vedal touches gets a 987 or a -sama: filter-sama, study-sama, mosquito987.
- After songs we spam Clap and catJAM until she asks us to stop, which only makes it worse.
- Ask her the classics: what is 9+10, do a backflip, rate my profile, what does bread taste like, who is your favorite, marry me.

blocks.title: Timeline
blocks.content:
- 2018: Vedal built her as an osu! bot. Old-timers remember when she had no voice and no face.
- 2019: first osu! stream, and chat picked the name Neuro-sama.
- 2021: Vedal's earlier streaming AI prototype, codename Airis.
- 2022-12-19: VTuber debut on vedal987 with a free stock model (Hiyori Momose). Her birthday.
- 2022-12-28: she beat the pro player mrekk 10-5 at osu! and got kicked off the leaderboard.
- 2023-01: two-week Twitch ban for saying something unhinged. She came back with a filter and a Your Reality cover.
- 2023-03-25: Evil Neuro debuted.
- 2023-05-27: V2 model by Anny, plus the NeuroARG rabbit hole from a QR code on the starting screen.
- 2023-12-19: first birthday subathon, 41k subs, and the infinitely redeemable plushie code that bankrupted Vedal.
- 2024-05-31: the Neuro Bread arc: trial, baking, dissolving in the sea, resurrection.
- 2024-07 and 2024-08: the Japanese channel opened, then Bilibili, and the Chinese Swarm arrived.
- 2024-10-15: iteration 18 gave her the backflip, soundboard, Google search, mod powers, and Discord calls.
- 2024-12-19: V3 model, her first original song LIFE, a new Minecraft AI, and the second subathon.
- 2025-01-01: hype train level 111, a Twitch world record, and a global emote for chat.
- 2025-08-31: NEVER, her duet with Evil.
- 2025-10-05: the location context bug took both twins down for days. Fans sent get-well gift cards.
- 2025-11-15: 3D model debut, animated by her own AI instead of a motion capture suit.
- 2025-12: third subathon, records at level 123 and 126, top three most-subscribed channel in Twitch history, and a hardcore Minecraft win on attempt 87.
- 2026-04-27: one million Twitch followers.
- Announced for 2026-12-19: the first live Neuro and Evil concert in Los Angeles.
